dict.string: Wake Tracker needs permission to start a water-sports workout session so sensors stay active. Alpha builds still do not save the finished workout into Health.
Wake Tracker requests workout write access only to run a live session for sensors; finished workouts are not saved during alpha testing.
Wake Tracker records GPS during cable-park wakeboarding sessions for alpha data collection.
Wake Tracker records GPS for the full park session, including when the wrist is down.
Wake Tracker records device motion to collect alpha training data for start/swim/walk detection.
